definitions.explanation: Lacking physical coordination or manual skill. Unable to perform tasks requiring fine motor skills well.
Unable to express oneself well or handle social situations smoothly. Often used about one's inability to show feelings or communicate effectively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦だから→だから：00924_dakara⟧、⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm clumsy, so I'm not good at cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられない→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: He's awkward and can't express his feelings well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手先|てさき}→手先：12939_tesaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{折|お}り{紙|がみ}→折り紙：05408_origami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{折|お}れない→折る：01263_oru⟧。
examples.english: I'm clumsy with my hands and can't fold origami well.

examples.japanese: {不器用|ぶきよう}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦しか→しか：09959_shika⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦それでも→それでも：00382_soredemo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: I can only live life in my clumsy way, but that's fine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えよう→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I love how he tries so hard to express his feelings, even though he's awkward about it.

examples.japanese: {不器用|ぶきよう}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I may be clumsy, but I'm doing my best.

notes:
TWO MAIN MEANINGS:

1) PHYSICAL: Not good with one's hands
・⟦{手先|てさき}→手先：12939_tesaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不器用|ぶきよう} (clumsy with one's hands)
・{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{手|て}つき→手つき：noentry⟧ (clumsy hand movements)

2) EMOTIONAL/SOCIAL: Unable to express feelings or navigate relationships smoothly
・⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不器用|ぶきよう} (clumsy at life)
・⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不器用|ぶきよう} (bad at showing affection)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a clumsy/awkward person)
・{不器用|ぶきよう}⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (though clumsy, nevertheless...)

NUANCE:
Often used with a sense of sympathy or endearment. A {不器用|ぶきよう} person who tries hard can be seen as admirable.

CONTRAST:
・{不器用|ぶきよう} ↔ ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧ (clumsy ↔ dexterous/skillful)
